name: Pickup Location Selector
summary: Product-context location search and single pickup-intent selection composed from canonical Input, Button, and native Radio without reserving inventory.

variants.name: default
variants.description: One searchable list-first pickup selection surface.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Intrinsic size with a private component-container stacking threshold.

states.name: ready
states.description: Eligible target results and the complete Radio list are available.

states.name: selected
states.description: One stable location id is current pickup intent; this is not a reservation.

states.name: loading
states.description: Target search is pending; stale results are suppressed and controls are temporarily unavailable.

states.name: empty
states.description: The completed search has no eligible locations and manual search remains available.

states.name: error
states.description: Target search failed with truthful retry guidance and no stale eligible choices.

behavior.name: manualSearch
behavior.description: Manual search remains available regardless of geolocation or map support. The target owns geocoding, requests, ordering, cancellation, retry, stale suppression, results, history, privacy, and analytics.

behavior.name: explicitGeolocation
behavior.description: Geolocation may be requested only after the explicit localized action; mounting, focusing, typing, search submission, or opening the surface never prompts permission.

behavior.name: singleSelection
behavior.description: Canonical native Radios own one selection. Stateful targets control selectedLocationId/onLocationSelect or initialize native checkedness without independent item booleans.

behavior.name: pickupIntent
behavior.description: Selection records pickup intent only for the exact current product, variant, and market. It never reserves inventory or promises fulfilment; Product Form, Cart, or Checkout confirms or rejects it truthfully.

behavior.name: resultLifecycle
behavior.description: The shared product/fulfilment coordinator owns status truth, exact merchandise context, provider authority, stale suppression, focus, and concise announcements. Invalid or stale choices are removed atomically.

behavior.name: optionalMap
behavior.description: A capable target may add a synchronized map. List and map project the same selectedLocationId; map failure or absence leaves every result, detail, and selection action available in the list.

behavior.name: dependencyComposition
behavior.description: D9 consumes canonical Input, Button, and Radio markup, focus, form, validation, disabled, and keyboard behavior without recreating their implementations.

accessibility: Use a visible heading to name the section and one visibly labelled canonical search Input; placeholder text never replaces either name.
Keep manual search available without geolocation or a map. Request device location only after the explicit localized Button action and provide target-owned privacy disclosure.
Group eligible location Radios in a native Fieldset with a first Legend. Give every Radio a stable location-id value, visible name, and associated text-complete address and availability details.
Retain native Radio Tab, Space, arrow-key, checked, focus, and form behavior; control one selectedLocationId rather than independent item booleans.
Expose one coherent busy/result status and alert only new errors. Remove stale choices before presenting a new exact product/variant/market snapshot.

Do not communicate eligibility or selection by color, border, pin, or map alone. The complete list remains usable under map failure, forced colors, zoom, text spacing, RTL, reduced motion, and narrow containers.
Selection must not announce inventory reservation or fulfilment confirmation; the owning transaction surface reports acceptance, rejection, or stale recovery.

web.notes: Canonical Input/Button/Radio composition, native search/choice semantics, states, list-first layout, optional map slot, and container response are implemented; provider and transaction coordination remain target-owned.

shopify.notes: Shopify can map selected-variant store availability, but search/geocoding, intent persistence, exact market/product coordinator integration, cart/checkout confirmation, localization, editor, and live-store proof remain required.

react.notes: Docs target demonstrates one controlled query, selectedLocationId, result status, and shared renderer without making React canonical.
